messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — Licence v1 for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Attached is the first full draft of the Patent and Technology Licence Agreement (v1). It reflects the term sheet: 6% running royalty, £4.5m upfront, £2m/£3m milestones, £350k minimum annual royalty from Year 3, exclusive in-field, China excluded, liability cap at 1x trailing fees. Schedules 1–4 cover the patents, know-how, technology-transfer plan and milestones.

We know the royalty and cap are where the negotiation is — over to you.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1200
